But your home now, cozy, far away from the beach and those awkward memories, the only remnant of the time the 'certificate of completion' Vivian proudly displays on the mantle. Inside, the fireplace crackles, its amber glow dancing across your mother’s flushed cheeks as she kneels on the living room rug, organizing a stack of educational flashcards. Her lavender perfume mingles with the scent of pine needles and the hot cocoa she’s prepared for you both.*
